screening_method_note: Every description field of all 5 records written by SD-29's race-trait lane pilot (src/bin/ingest_race_traits.rs, book monster_codex) was screened through rules_core::pi_screening against the bounded, documented term list in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md; zero hits. The pilot ingests ONE of this book's 18 .lst files, mc_abilities_race.lst, and only its 5 in-scope-race rows -- the book's other record families (class_feature, feat, spell, equipment, equipment_modifier, companion, monster) are not ingested, and its 6 Ratfolk racial-trait rows are deliberately not written because Ratfolk has no ingested race chassis. records_processed is therefore 5, the real on-disk count, not a claim about the book. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring scan and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see.
